"Combustion" shall mean combining or causing combustion of vegetables and fruits;
"Disinfectant" shall mean reducing the amount of microorganisms in the environment through chemical agents or
physical means to the level that does not reduce the safety or appropriateness of food;
"Drinking Water" shall mean water sufficiently free of contaminants to cause disease or adverse physical effects
